About

Experience an all-Beethoven evening featuring the dramatic Coriolan Overture, the virtuosic Triple Concerto performed by Monarch Chamber Players, and the composer's legendary Fifth Symphony—one of the most iconic and exhilarating works ever written.

Time & Location

Complementary Pre-Concert Reception: 4:00 PM
Concert Starts: 5:00 PM
Rudder Theatre

Featuring Monarch Chamber Players:

Sam Park, violin
David Dietz, cello
Yvonne Chen, piano

Program:

Beethoven: Coriolan Overture, Op. 62
Beethoven: Concerto for Violin, Cello and Piano in C major, Op. 56 "Triple"
Beethoven: Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67
